title: MKT 102 - Principles of Marketing II
topics: New product development and product life cycle

items.q: Which of the following best describes Product mix?
o: the preparation a salesperson makes before meeting a prospect
the complete set of product lines a company offers for sale
the period when a product's sales and profits rise quickly
information collected fresh for the particular problem at hand
items.s: Product mix: the complete set of product lines a company offers for sale. The other options describe Growth stage, Primary data, Pre-approach.

items.q: The statement “disagreement among channel members over goals, roles or rewards” describes which of the following?
o: Physical distribution
Inventory control
Channel conflict
Warehousing
items.s: Channel conflict is disagreement among channel members over goals, roles or rewards.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Competitor-based pricing?
o: a product priced low to attract customers who then buy other items
the review of a firm's market, customers, competitors and internal position
setting prices by reference to what rival firms charge
the period when a product's sales and profits rise quickly
items.s: Competitor-based pricing: setting prices by reference to what rival firms charge. The other options describe Loss leader, Situation analysis, Growth stage.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Advertising media?
o: the period when a product's sales and profits rise quickly
anything offered to a market to satisfy a need or want
the channels such as newspapers, radio and television that carry adverts
selling a new product in a small area to test customer response
items.s: Advertising media: the channels such as newspapers, radio and television that carry adverts. The other options describe Growth stage, Product, Test marketing.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Product line?
o: selling a new product in a small area to test customer response
a group of closely related products sold by one firm
a business that sells goods directly to the final consumer
the full launch of a new product into the open market
items.s: Product line: a group of closely related products sold by one firm. The other options describe Retailer, Commercialisation, Test marketing.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Promotion.
o: the printed details on a product that identify it and give directions
the systematic gathering and analysis of information about marketing problems
communication aimed at persuading customers to buy a product
the search for potential customers who may need the product
items.s: Promotion: communication aimed at persuading customers to buy a product. The other options describe Marketing research, Labelling, Prospecting.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Packaging?
o: the pronounceable part of a brand, made up of words
the sales volume at which total revenue just covers total cost
disagreement among channel members over goals, roles or rewards
the container or wrapper that protects a product and carries information
items.s: Packaging: the container or wrapper that protects a product and carries information. The other options describe Channel conflict, Break-even point, Brand name.
